title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1+2 DHE POST PARKIMI TE REZIDENCA MARA NE DON BOSCO!
description_sq:
Apartment 2+1+2 dhe post parkimi te Rezidenca Mara ne Don Bosco per shitje!
Rezidenca Mara eshte e pozicionuar ne Rrugen Ibrahim Pashe Bushatlliu, me orientim Jug – Perendim – Veri.
Vendndodhja strategjike paraqet potencial te jashtezakonshem zhvillimi, duke krijuar nje mjedis dinamik mes te garantuarit komoditet ne jetese dhe sukses ne biznes.
Nje godine e vetme qe ploteson cdo nevoje tuajen duke ofruar mundesine e nje pervoje te vertete per te nderthurur komoditetin dhe funksionalitetin. Cdo detaj eshte projektuar me kujdes per te siguruar nje jetese te sigurt, cilesore dhe te pershtatshme per cdo familje.
Ne kete Rezidence ofrojme apartament 2+1+2 per shitje. I vendosur ne katin e 5 te banimit, me siperfaqe neto prej 104 m2, organizohet ne 1 sallon ndenjie, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 2 ballkone. Me orientim Jug, ofron ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites. Ne cmim perfshihet dhe 1 post parkimi ne katin -1.
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni!
title_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 AND PARKING POST AT RESIDENCE MARA IN DON BOSCO!
description_en: Apartment 2+1+2 and parking post at Residence Mara in Don Bosco for sale! The Mara Residence is located on Ibrahim Pashe Bushatlliu Street, facing South - West - North. The strategic location presents exceptional development potential, creating a dynamic environment between guaranteed comfort in life and success in business. A single building that meets your every need, offering the possibility of a real experience to combine comfort and functionality. Every detail has been carefully designed to ensure a safe, quality and convenient living for every family. In this residence we offer a 2+1+2 apartment for sale. Located on the 5th floor of the residence, with a net area of ​​104 m2, it is organized in 1 living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies. Facing South, it offers natural lighting throughout the day. The price includes 1 parking spot on the -1st floor. For more information contact us!
